plans.estimate_assumption: STANDARD: 1 request/prompt/message = 1 agentic model call of 20,000 input tokens (18,000 cache-read + 2,000 uncached) + 1,500 output = 21,500 tokens. Window plans: 4 usable 5h windows/day x 30 days = 120 windows/month, then capped by weekly cap x 30/7 and by any monthly cap (whichever binds first). Dollar-pool plans: pool / blended reference rate for the same token mix at Claude Sonnet 5.5 list ($2 in / $0.20 cache-read / $10 out per Mtok) = $1.0512/Mtok. Anthropic publishes no token/prompt numbers; estimate converts SECONDARY measurements (finopsllm.com, Sept 2026, Claude Code on Opus 5, 96% cache reads) into the standard mix by API-dollar equivalence: measured mix = $0.843/Mtok at Opus 5 list vs standard mix $2.628/Mtok, factor 0.321.
plans.notes: Secondary: ~155M tokens/5h session (projected from 5x) but weekly cap MEASURED ~1.9B tokens (hit twice) -> weekly binds: 155M x 4/day would hit 1.9B in ~3 days. So at full use 20x gives only ~1.75x the monthly tokens of 5x for 2x the price. API-equivalent at Opus 5 list ~$6860/mo.
